title: LIMA offline CVE index (one JSON file = one array of entries)
description: Frozen entry contract for the offline CVE matcher in lima/agent_report.py (plan Task 6). load_cve_index enforces the same rules without a jsonschema dependency: exactly these six fields, CVE id pattern, non-empty component/affected_paths/summary, string commits (empty string = unknown timeline).

component.description: Component path; matched as a mutual non-empty prefix of the finding's component.

affected_paths.description: fnmatch globs (fnmatchcase, case-exact) over the finding's repository-relative path.

introduced_commit.description: Introducing commit hash; empty string means unknown timeline.

fixed_commit.description: Fixing commit hash; empty string means unknown timeline.
